# Dependencies
 
Keep directories within `###` level sorted in alphabetical order.

### fmt

Superior string formatting library.

- Upstream: git submodule <https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt.git>
- Version: 12.2.0
- License: MIT

### glad

Defines pointer functions for hardware definitions of OpenGL.

- Upstream: <https://gen.glad.sh/>
- Generation Settings
    - Core, Common
    - gl: Version 4.6
    - All Extensions added
- License: MIT

### glm

Linear algebra library based on GLSL math type syntax/functions

- Upstream: git submodule <https://github.com/g-truc/glm.git>
- Version: 1.0.3
- License: MIT

### SDL

Platform Specific Implementations (Window, Events, OpenGL Context Creation).

- Upstream: git submodule <https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL>
- Version: release-3.4.12
- License: MIT

### SDL_image

Loading images files such as PNG, JPG, etc.

- Upstream: git submodule <https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_image.git>
- Version: release-3.4.4
- License: MIT

### unordered_dense

Super fast dictionary implementation that packs data instead of using buckets.

- Upstream: git submodule <https://github.com/martinus/unordered_dense>
- Version: v4.8.1
- License: MIT
